risk_note: RV2 (orders). Mounts five implemented console writes (adminApproveClaimItem, adminRejectClaimItem, adminHoldOrder, adminUnholdOrder, adminReassignOrder; D10-490 ①, D10-528, D10-70 J-1 lifted): new controllers on OrdersAdminModule.forAdmin, admin entry only, order.claim, order.hold (no step-up), order.assign (totp), audit in the same transaction. Real ports wired from app.module: settlement attribution onClaimApproved / onAdminAssigned, rebate admin commands, snapshots, sources, pidScene read by (app_id, platform, pid) with every status counted (a retired taolijin slot keeps its scene). All reads inside the attribution transaction run on the transaction handle, so the small admin pool cannot self-lock. Use-case logic, amounts and lock order unchanged; placeholders removed. x-implementation: planned removed for the five, generated files regenerated. Rights imports moved to B1-10n (deps B2-04lb). The one frozen test change is the order-write block of [AC-CT-24n#1]; the block split landed first as #2113; the other rows are red_exempt. Full verification by the required CI checks (04:16 general rule).
